data.change_summary: Updated the user-visible chemistry surfaces so threshold event summaries now spell out NH3-N and N-basis units, the overview screen restores GH/KH derivation labels plus 7-ion TDS and conductivity estimate units, and API snapshot responses now emit legacy chemistry keys alongside the explicit renamed fields with semantics/scope metadata for the 7-ion estimate.
outstanding_risks: Repository has unrelated pre-existing modifications in `crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs`, several `tank_core` tests, and `.ralph-burning/`; they were left untouched.
The overview copy change was validated with `cargo check -p tank_tui`, but there is still no dedicated render test asserting the exact TUI text.

steps.description: Inspected the event, snapshot/API, and overview paths called out in the review feedback.
Changed threshold event summaries to include explicit chemistry bases and added regression coverage for the rendered text.
Expanded overview chemistry/system copy to show GH/KH derivation labels plus estimated 7-ion TDS and conductivity units.

Centralized API snapshot serialization behind helpers that emit legacy chemistry aliases and semantics metadata on `/snapshot`, `/snapshot/chemistry`, `/time/step`, `/load`, and scenario-load responses.
Ran targeted tests and compile checks for the touched crates.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test events` passed (7 tests), including the new explicit-unit summary regression.
`cargo test -p tank_api` passed (2 tests), covering legacy chemistry aliases and 7-ion estimate semantics metadata.
`cargo check -p tank_tui` completed successfully after the overview copy changes.
